meaning: Rather than lamenting over the past, you should focus your energy into what you can do right now for the future.

japanese: 日本における今年の賃上げはなだらかなものだった。
romaji: nippon niokeru konnen no chin'age hanadarakanamonodatta.
meaning: Wage settlements in Japan this year were moderate.

japanese: 小学校の先生達のことが懐かしい。
romaji: shougakkou no senseitooru nokotoga natsukashii.
meaning: I miss my elementary school teachers.

japanese: これはなでる。
romaji: kore wa naderu.
meaning: This is to stroke, to pat.

japanese: これは何しろ。
romaji: kore wa nanishiro.
meaning: This is you know, in any case.

japanese: 僕には警察よりも何よりもみんながいてくれることの方が心強いのですよ。
romaji: boku niha keisatsu yorimo nani yorimominnagaitekurerukotono hougakokorozuyoi nodesuyo.
meaning: For my part, having you lot with me is more reassuring than the police or anything!

japanese: これは生～。
romaji: kore wa nama ~.
meaning: This is live ～.

japanese: 彼をからかうなんて生意気だ。
romaji: kare wokarakaunante namaiki da.
meaning: It is impudent of you to jest at him.

japanese: これは生演奏。
romaji: kore wa namaensou.
meaning: This is live performance.

japanese: 父は私に怠けるなと忠告した。
romaji: chichi wa watashi ni namake runato chuukoku shita.
meaning: My father advised me not to be lazy.

japanese: これは生出演。
romaji: kore wa namashutsuen.
meaning: This is live appearance.

japanese: 先程のはＰ波でした。Ｓ波が来ます。
romaji: sakihodo noha P nami deshita. S nami ga kima su.
meaning: That was the P-wave just now. The S-wave is coming.

japanese: 必ず、全ての品物が一列に並ぶようにして下さい。
romaji: kanarazu, subete no shinamono ga ichiretsu ni narabu younishite kudasai.
meaning: See to it that all the items are arranged in a row.

japanese: 彼のねらいが何だかわかってきた。
romaji: kano neraiga nanda kawakattekita.
meaning: I began to see what he was getting at.

japanese: なんとかそこで支えよ。入市を許すな。
romaji: nantokasokode sasae yo. nyuushi o yurusu na.
meaning: Hold them there! Don't let them into the city!

japanese: 彼女は何とかわいらしい少女なんでしょう。
romaji: kanojo wa nantoka wairashii shoujo nandeshou.
meaning: She's such a lovely girl!

japanese: 「それを乗り越えて、初めて少年は男にうんちゃらかんちゃらです」「何となくよさげな事を言おうってんなら、最後までちゃんと言えよ！」
romaji: ( sorewo norikoe te, hajimeteshounen wa otoko niuncharakancharadesu) ( nantonaku yosagena koto o io uttennara, saigo madechanto ie yo!)
meaning: "It is when you overcome that, that a boy becomes something-something" "If you're trying to say something important sounding keep talking right to the end!"

japanese: 彼女は交通事故にあっても何ともなかった。
romaji: kanojo wa koutsuujiko niattemo nanto monakatta.
meaning: She was none the worse for the traffic accident.

japanese: テクトロニクスの新ソフトウェアは、ロジック・アナライザを使う顧客のニーズにまさしく応えるものです。
romaji: tekutoronikusu no shin sofutouea ha, rojikku・anaraiza o tsukaukokyaku no niizu nimasashiku kotae rumonodesu.
meaning: Tektronix's new software perfectly responds to the needs of customers using logic analysers.

japanese: タマネギはジャガイモよりはやく煮える。
romaji: tamanegi wa jagaimo yorihayaku nie ru.
meaning: Onions cook more quickly than potatoes.

japanese: あははは、ほんっと、隠し事するのが苦手なんだね～。
romaji: ahahaha, hontto, kakushigoto surunoga nigate nandane ~.
meaning: A-hahaha, you really are bad at keeping secrets.

japanese: これは苦み。
romaji: kore wa ku mi.
meaning: This is bitterness.

japanese: 成功への鍵を握るのは教育である。
romaji: seikou heno kagi o nigiru noha kyouiku dearu.
meaning: It is education that is key to the success.

japanese: フランス語が憎い。
romaji: furansu go ga nikui.
meaning: I hate French.

japanese: トムのことが憎らしいけど、でも愛してるの。
romaji: tomu nokotoga nikurashii kedo, demo itoshi teruno.
meaning: I hate Tom, but I also love him.

japanese: 今いる市民が逃げ出すという事態が危惧されます。
romaji: imai ru shimin ga nigedasu toiu jitai ga kigu saremasu.
meaning: It is feared that those citizens now present will run away.

japanese: 彼らは銃でねらわれ豚のように逃げ回る。
romaji: karera wa juu deneraware buta noyouni nigemawaru.
meaning: They run like pigs from a gun.

japanese: 彼女はにこにこしてうれしそうだった。
romaji: kanojo hanikonikoshiteureshisoudatta.
meaning: She was all smiles.

japanese: アメリカは世界の１／４の二酸化炭素を排出しており、一人当たりの排出量も世界で最も多いのです。
romaji: amerika wa sekai no 1 / 4 no nisankatanso o haishutsu shiteori, hitoriatari tarino haishutsuryou mo sekai de mottomoooi nodesu.
meaning: 1/4 of the world's carbon dioxide emissions are from America: its per-capita emissions are also the greatest in the world.

japanese: 彼女はその日、１日中スキーをしていた。
romaji: kanojo hasono nichi, 1 nitchuu sukii woshiteita.
meaning: She was skiing all though the day.

japanese: 部長の都合が悪くなってしまったので、飲み会の日程は仕切り直しだね。
romaji: buchou no tsugou ga waruku natteshimattanode, nomikai no nittei wa shikirinaoshi dane.
meaning: We'll have to organize the drinking party all over again as the section chief can't make it now.

japanese: これは二泊三日。
romaji: kore wa nihakumikka.
meaning: This is two nights and three days.

japanese: 彼は動作が鈍い。
romaji: karehadousa ga nibui.
meaning: He is slow in action.

japanese: これは日本産。
romaji: kore wa nihonsan.
meaning: This is made in Japan.

japanese: 日本列島は酷暑に苛まれている。
romaji: nipponretsushima wa kokusho ni ijima reteiru.
meaning: The Japanese archipelago is struck by a terrible heat wave.

japanese: これは二メートルおき。
romaji: kore wa ni meetoru oki.
meaning: This is every two metres.

japanese: さっきからあの人一人でにやにやして。怪しい。
romaji: sakkikaraano hitohitori deniyaniyashite. ayashii.
meaning: That person has had an odd grin on his face for a while. What do you suppose is behind it?

japanese: 私自身も、当社に入社する前の会社では、２度ほどトップに直言した経験があります。
romaji: watashijishin mo, tousha ni nyuusha suru mae no kaisha deha, 2 do hodo toppu ni chokugen shita keiken gaarimasu.
meaning: I myself have, before becoming employed by this company, twice spoken bluntly to the people at the top.

japanese: 敵対企業を貶めたり、秘密情報を入手したりと、大企業に欠かせない存在であるため、ハイリスクながらハイリターンが望める仕事だ。
romaji: tekitaikigyou o sagesume tari, himitsujouhou o nyuushu shitarito, daikigyou ni kaka senai sonzai dearutame, hairisuku nagara hairitaan ga nozome ru shigoto da.
meaning: Causing competitors to fail, obtaining confidential information, something that big business just can't do without - high risk but at the same time high return work.

japanese: これはにらむ。
romaji: kore wa niramu.
meaning: This is to glare [stare] at.

japanese: 必ず弱火で煮立たないように煮ること。
romaji: kanarazuyowabi de nitata naiyouni niru koto.
meaning: Be sure to simmer on a low heat so it doesn't boil.

japanese: それは耳を疑うような話で、にわかには信じられない。
romaji: soreha mimi o utagau youna hanashi de, niwakaniha shinji rarenai.
meaning: I can't believe my ears, and won't accept it without further reason.

japanese: 「好色と倒錯の違いとは？」「好色なら羽を使うが、倒錯なら鶏をまるごと使う」
romaji: ( koushoku to tousaku no chigai toha ？) ( koushoku nara hane o tsukau ga, tousaku nara niwatori womarugoto tsukau)
meaning: "What's the difference between erotic and kinky?" "Erotic is when you use a feather and kinky is when you use a whole chicken."

japanese: 一般投票による「ピープルズ・チョイス賞」が今年も発表され、メル・ギブソンとジュリア・ロバーツが最も人気のある映画男優と女優に選ばれた。
romaji: ippantouhyou niyoru ( piipuruzu・choisu shou) ga konnen mo happyou sare, meru・gibuson to juria・robaatsu ga mottomoninki noaru eigadanyuu to joyuu ni eraba reta.
meaning: The "People's Choice" award, by public polling, was announced again this year and Mel Gibson and Julia Roberts were selected as the most popular male, and female, film actors.

japanese: 他人を憎むことは彼女とは相入れない。
romaji: tanin o nikumu kotoha kanojo toha souire nai.
meaning: Hating others is foreign to her.

japanese: 彼女は自分自身の服を全部自分で縫う。
romaji: kanojo wa jibunjishin no fuku o zenbujibun de nuu.
meaning: She makes all her own clothes.

japanese: これは抜き出す。
romaji: kore wa nukidasu.
meaning: This is to pull out.

japanese: 問題はいかにして我々が現在の困難を切り抜けるかである。
romaji: mondai haikanishite wareware ga genzai no konnan o kirinuke rukadearu.
meaning: The problem is how we cope with the present difficulties.

japanese: これは値～。
romaji: kore wa atai ~.
meaning: This is price.

japanese: 収穫高が少なかったため、小麦の値段が、ここ６か月で値上がりした。
romaji: shuukakutaka ga sukunaka ttatame, komugi no nedan ga, koko 6 ka gatsu de neagari shita.
meaning: Because of the poor harvest, wheat prices have gone up in the last six months.

japanese: 来月から家賃を値上げします。
romaji: raigetsu kara yachin o neage shimasu.
meaning: We will increase the rent next month.

japanese: 息子が何とか勉強する気になってくれることを願うよ。
romaji: musuko ga nantokabenkyou suru kini nattekurerukotowo negau yo.
meaning: I hope my son will bring himself to study hard.

japanese: 肉が値下がりした。
romaji: niku ga nesagari shita.
meaning: The price of meat dropped.

japanese: その取っ手を右にねじると箱は開きます。
romaji: sono totsute o migi ninejiruto hako wa hiraki masu.
meaning: Twist that knob to the right and the box will open.

japanese: これは熱する。
romaji: kore wa atsusu ru.
meaning: This is to heat.

japanese: 母は今テニスに熱中している。
romaji: haha wa ima tenisu ni netchuu shiteiru.
meaning: Mother is now involved in tennis.

japanese: 心配や寝不足で彼女は最近１０ポンド近くも痩せてしまった。
romaji: shinpai ya nebusoku de kanojo wa saikin 1 0 pondo chikaku mo yase teshimatta.
meaning: Recently what with anxiety and lack of sleep, she has lost almost ten pounds.

japanese: 彼は名前を呼ばれたときもう少しで眠り込むところだった。
romaji: karehanamae o yoba retatokimou sukoshi de nemurikomu tokorodatta.
meaning: He was almost asleep when he heard his name called.

japanese: 眠ると体の機能がゆっくりになり、体温が下がる。
romaji: nemuru to karada no kinou gayukkurininari, taion ga saga ru.
meaning: When we are asleep, bodily functions slow down and body temperature falls.

japanese: レーシング・カーのドライバー達は、大金をねらうばかりでなく、また、レースのスリルを味わおうとするのである。
romaji: reeshingu・kaa no doraibaa tooru ha, taikin woneraubakaridenaku, mata, reesu no suriru o ajiwa outosurunodearu.
meaning: Racing car drivers aren't just in it for the prize money but also for the thrill of racing.

japanese: 年賀状を書くのは日本の習慣である。
romaji: nengajou o kaku noha nippon no shuukan dearu.
meaning: Writing new year's cards is a Japanese institution.

japanese: 年月を経て物事がどう変わっていくか見るのは面白そうだ。
romaji: toshitsuki o hetemonogoto gadou kawa tteikuka miru noha omoshiroso uda.
meaning: It would be fun to see how things change over the years.

japanese: 無理だと思うわ。年中、仕事で手一杯の人だから。
romaji: muri dato omou wa. nenjuu, shigoto de teippai no nin dakara.
meaning: I don't think she could spare the time because she is always busy with her work.

japanese: これは年代別。
romaji: kore wa nendaibetsu.
meaning: This is by age.

japanese: これは～年度。
romaji: kore wa ~ nendo.
meaning: This is ～ financial [fiscal] year.

japanese: 僕は決して農業が嫌いな訳じゃない。
romaji: bokuhakesshitenougyou ga kirai na wake janai.
meaning: By no means do I dislike farming.

japanese: 私たちは農作業を手伝いました。
romaji: watashitachi wa nousagyou o tetsudai mashita.
meaning: We helped on the farm.

japanese: これは農水相。
romaji: kore wa nousuisou.
meaning: This is Minister for Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.

japanese: これは納税。
romaji: kore wa nouzei.
meaning: This is tax payment.

japanese: 誰もが能率を上げるよう努力するが、ほとんどの人がそうできないようだ。
romaji: daremo ga nouritsu o age ruyou doryoku suruga, hotondono nin gasoudekinaiyouda.
meaning: Everyone strives for efficiency but few seem to attain it.

japanese: 彼女は、ノーベル賞をとった後も相変わらず控え目である。
romaji: kanojo ha, nooberu shou wototta nochi mo aikawarazuhikaeme dearu.
meaning: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.

japanese: 彼女は生徒たちが彼女の言葉を聞き逃すといけないからゆっくり話しました。
romaji: kanojo wa seito tachiga kanojo no kotoba o kikinogasu toikenaikarayukkuri hanashi mashita.
meaning: She spoke slowly in case the students should miss her words.

japanese: 腹を立てると彼はよく口汚くののしる。
romaji: hara o tate ruto kareha yoku kuchigitanaku nonoshiru.
meaning: He often swears when he is angry.

japanese: 暗闇の中、俺は遠ざかる後姿に必死に手を伸ばす。
romaji: kurayami no naka, ore wa tooza karu ushirosugata ni hisshi ni te o noba su.
meaning: In the darkness, I frantically reach out towards the receding figure.

japanese: 仕事が多いので旅行はのびのびになっている。
romaji: shigoto ga ooi node ryokou hanobinobininatteiru.
meaning: I have so much work to do that I have to put off my trip.

japanese: まもなく、上り電車が通過します。ご注意ください。
romaji: mamonaku, noboridensha ga tsuuka shimasu. go chuui kudasai.
meaning: An inbound train will be passing shortly. Please be careful.

japanese: これは乗り～。
romaji: kore wa nori ~.
meaning: This is ride [over] ～.

japanese: 列車に乗り遅れるな。
romaji: ressha ni noriokure runa.
meaning: Don't be late for the train.

japanese: 彼の大胆な決意のおかげで危機を乗り越えることができた。
romaji: kanodaitan na ketsui nookagede kiki o norikoe rukotogadekita.
meaning: Thanks to his bold decision, he was able to ride out the crisis.

japanese: これは乗り越す。
romaji: kore wa norikosu.
meaning: This is to go beyond one's stop.

japanese: 彼はナンシーがタクシーに乗り込むのを見つけた。
romaji: kareha nanshii ga takushii ni norikomu nowo mitsu keta.
meaning: He caught sight of Nancy getting into a taxi.

japanese: 休日で車は街道をのろのろと動いた。
romaji: kyuujitsu de kuruma wa kaidou wonoronoroto ugoi ta.
meaning: The holiday traffic crawled along the highway.

japanese: ジョン君は働きすぎだよ。座ってしばらくはのん気にかまえなさい。
romaji: jon kun wa hataraki sugidayo. suwatsu teshibarakuhanon kini kamaenasai.
meaning: John, you're working too hard. Sit down and take it easy for a while.

japanese: 彼女はもっとのんびりした生活を望んだが、あの状況ではそれは不可能であった。
romaji: kanojo hamottononbirishita seikatsu o nozon daga, ano joukyou dehasoreha fukanou deatta.
meaning: She wished for a more relaxing life, but that was impossible under the circumstances.

japanese: アメリカは世界の１／４の二酸化炭素を排出しており、一人当たりの排出量も世界で最も多いのです。
romaji: amerika wa sekai no 1 / 4 no nisankatanso o haishutsu shiteori, hitoriatari tarino haishutsuryou mo sekai de mottomoooi nodesu.
meaning: 1/4 of the world's carbon dioxide emissions are from America: its per-capita emissions are also the greatest in the world.

japanese: このため、会談の席の配置では米国と相対して座る場所を求めた。
romaji: konotame, kaidan no seki no haichi deha beikoku to soutai shite suwarubasho o motome ta.
meaning: So they sought a place such that the conference seating would have them facing the Americans.

japanese: 彼は学校の売店で文房具を買った。
romaji: karehagakkou no baiten de bunbougu o katsu ta.
meaning: He bought some stationery at the school store.

japanese: もうよろしくてよ。実のない会話にはうんざりですわ。
romaji: mouyoroshikuteyo. mi nonai kaiwa nihaunzaridesuwa.
meaning: That is enough. I have had it with fruitless conversation.

japanese: お墓には供花が供えられていた。
romaji: o haka niha kuge ga sonae rareteita.
meaning: An offering of flowers had been placed at the grave.

japanese: これは～破壊。
romaji: kore wa ~ hakai.
meaning: This is ～ destruction.

japanese: 私は父の墓参りをした。
romaji: watashi wa chichi no hakamairi woshita.
meaning: I visited my father's grave.

japanese: 突然の吐き気が彼は抑えきれなかった。
romaji: totsuzen no hakike ga karehaosae kirenakatta.
meaning: A sudden wave of nausea overpowered him.

japanese: はきはきと意見を言ってください。
romaji: hakihakito iken o itte kudasai.
meaning: Please state your opinion crisply and clearly.

japanese: 時には弱音を吐くけど。
romaji: tokini wa yowane o haku kedo.
meaning: Sometimes I will be weak.

japanese: 台所をきれいに掃くのを忘れないように。
romaji: daidokoro wokireini haku nowo wasure naiyouni.
meaning: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.

japanese: お父さんの破産は家名の汚れでした。
romaji: o tousan no hasan wa kamei no yogore deshita.
meaning: Father's bankruptcy was a blot on the family's reputation.

japanese: 部屋の中で走り回るな。
romaji: heya no naka de hashirimawaru na.
meaning: Don't run around in the room.

japanese: 彼女は恥ずかしがりで無口だ。
romaji: kanojo wa hazukashi garide mukuchi da.
meaning: She is shy and talks little.

japanese: 自分の顔が、パスポートの顔写真のようになってきたら、旅に出た方がいい。
romaji: jibun no kao ga, pasupooto no kaojashin noyouninattekitara, tabi ni detahouga ii.
meaning: When you're beginning to look like the photo in your passport, you should go on a holiday.

japanese: 体が触れられたとき肌の感覚器官は脳に信号を送り、エンドルフィンのような化学物質が放出される。
romaji: karada ga furera retatoki hada no kankakukikan wa nou ni shingou o okuri, endorufin noyouna kagakubusshitsu ga houshutsu sareru.
meaning: When the body is touched, receptors in the skin send messages to the brain causing the release of chemicals such as endorphins.

japanese: 彼女は畑の作物が育ち、りんごの実が赤く熟すのをみました。
romaji: kanojo wa hatake no sakumotsu ga sodachi, ringono mi ga akakujukusu nowomimashita.
meaning: She watched the gardens grow, and she watched the apples turn red and ripen.

japanese: 彼らはすぐに買っておいた食料品を使い果たしてしまった。
romaji: karera hasuguni katsu teoita shokuryouhin o tsukaihata shiteshimatta.
meaning: They soon used up their food supplies.

japanese: 労働交渉では組合の指導者が重要な役割を果たす。
romaji: roudoukoushou deha kumiai no shidousha ga juuyounayakuwari o hata su.
meaning: In labor negotiation union leaders play an important role.

japanese: これは初～。
romaji: kore wa hatsu ~.
meaning: This is first ～.

japanese: これは～発。
romaji: kore wa ~ hatsu.
meaning: This is departing from ～.

japanese: これは発芽。
romaji: kore wa hatsuga.
meaning: This is germination.

japanese: これは～パック。
romaji: kore wa ~ pakku.
meaning: This is ～ carton [pack].

japanese: ほとんどの科学的進歩は当然のことについての発見に過ぎない。
romaji: hotondono kagakutekishinpo wa touzen nokotonitsuiteno hakken ni sugina i.
meaning: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.

japanese: 教育のメルマガを発行したい方はこちら！
romaji: kyouiku no merumaga o hakkoushi tai kataha kochira!
meaning: People who want to put out an ezine on education, come this way!

japanese: これは初公開。
romaji: kore wa hatsukoukai.
meaning: This is first public exhibition.

japanese: 秋になると日はだんだん短くなり夜はさむくなってきました。彼女は初霜が木の葉を黄色や赤に変えていくのをみていました。
romaji: aki ninaruto nichi hadandan mijikaku nari yoru hasamukunattekimashita. kanojo wa hatsushimo ga konoha o kiiro ya akanikae teikunowomiteimashita.
meaning: In the fall, when the days grew shorter and the nights colder, she watched the first frost turn the leaves to bright yellow and orange and red.

japanese: 列車は今日の午後１時半に発車します。
romaji: ressha wa kyou no gogo 1 jihan ni hassha shimasu.
meaning: The train leaves at one-thirty this afternoon.

japanese: これは初出場。
romaji: kore wa hatsushutsujou.
meaning: This is first appearance.

japanese: ソレノイドへの突入電流でノイズが発生します。
romaji: sorenoido heno totsunyuudenryuu de noizu ga hassei shimasu.
meaning: Noise is produced by the sudden flow of current into a solenoid.

japanese: トランプでインチキをするという良い発想を偶然思い付いた。
romaji: toranpu de inchiki wosurutoiu yoihassou o guuzenomoitsui ta.
meaning: I hit on the terrific idea of cheating at cards by chance.

japanese: ネットワークの発達で、かつてないほど大量の文が世界中を駆け巡っています。
romaji: nettowaaku no hattatsu de, katsutenaihodo tairyou no bun ga sekaijuu o kakemegutsu teimasu.
meaning: With the development of networks a huge and unprecedented volume of messages flies around the world.

japanese: 現在、韓国と日本の政府との間で、教科書問題が両国間にかかわる重要な問題へと発展しています。
romaji: genzai, kankoku to nippon no seifu tono kan de, kyoukashomondai ga ryoukokukan nikakawaru juuyounamondai heto hatten shiteimasu.
meaning: At present the text book issue between the Korean and Japanese governments is developing into a significant problem affecting both countries.

japanese: 環境汚染についての恐れは、人々に発電所の近くに家を建てることを思いとどまらせた。
romaji: kankyouosen nitsuiteno osore ha, hitobito ni hatsudensho no chikaku ni ie o tate rukotowo omoi todomaraseta.
meaning: Fear of pollution discouraged people from building homes near power plants.

japanese: 彼女が初舞台を踏んだのは1969年であった。
romaji: kanojo ga hatsubutai o fun danoha 1969 nen deatta.
meaning: Her first appearance on the stage was in 1969.

japanese: それを発明した教授は大学から相当の対価を受ける権利がある。
romaji: sorewo hatsumei shita kyouju wa daigaku kara soutou no taika o ukerukenri gaaru.
meaning: The professor who invented it has the right to reasonable remuneration from the university.

japanese: これは初優勝。
romaji: kore wa hatsuyuushou.
meaning: This is first victory.

japanese: まもなく初雪が降った。
romaji: mamonaku hatsuyuki ga futsu ta.
meaning: The first snow came before long.

japanese: 子供にお金を残そうなんて考えずにパーッと派手に遊んで使い切って下さいね。
romaji: kodomo nio kin o nokoso unante kangae zuni paatsu to hade ni asondetsukaikitsu te kudasai ne.
meaning: Don't think about leaving money for your kids, use it all up and enjoy yourself with flair.

japanese: 話し合いはちょっと中断した。
romaji: hanashiai hachotto chuudan shita.
meaning: There was a brief break in the discussion.

japanese: 明日彼とその事を話し合うことになっている。
romaji: ashitakare tosono koto o hanashiau kotoninatteiru.
meaning: I am to talk over the matter with him tomorrow.

japanese: 彼女があなたに話しかけるのを拒否するのも当然だ。なぜなら彼女はとても機嫌が悪いからだ。
romaji: kanojo gaanatani hanashi kakerunowo kyohi surunomo touzen da. nazenara kanojo hatotemo kigen ga warui karada.
meaning: She may well refuse to speak to you because she's in a very bad mood.

japanese: これは話し込む。
romaji: kore wa hanashikomu.
meaning: This is to be deep in talk.

japanese: これは話し出す。
romaji: kore wa hanashidasu.
meaning: This is to begin talking.

japanese: 話しぶりから彼はアメリカ人ではないことがわかる。
romaji: hanashi burikara kareha amerika nin dehanaikotogawakaru.
meaning: I know from his speech that he is not an American.

japanese: ２人とも今日は大活躍だったみたいね。先生も鼻が高いわ。
romaji: 2 nin tomo konnichihadaikatsuyaku dattamitaine. sensei mo hana ga takai wa.
meaning: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.

japanese: これは鼻で笑う。
romaji: kore wa hana de warau.
meaning: This is to laugh scornfully.

japanese: 結婚直前、泥酔の父親は「何処の馬の骨か解らん奴に娘をやれん！」と花婿に怒鳴りつけた。
romaji: kekkonchokuzen, deisui no chichioya wa ( doko no uma no hone ka wakara n yatsu ni musume woyaren!) to hanamuko ni donari tsuketa.
meaning: Just before the wedding, the drunken father shouted at the groom: "I won't hand out my daughter to some stranger!"

japanese: ショービジネスというのは本当に華やかだ。
romaji: shoobijinesu toiunoha hontou ni hanaya kada.
meaning: Show business is really glamorous.

japanese: 彼女は結婚式で花嫁の付き添い役をつとめた。
romaji: kanojo wa kekkonshiki de hanayome no tsukisoiyaku wotsutometa.
meaning: She was a bridesmaid at the wedding.

japanese: 犬が跳ねるのをごらん。
romaji: inu ga hane runowogoran.
meaning: Look at the dog jump.

japanese: 彼は停止信号を見なかったので、もう少しで道路を渡ろうとしていた子供をはねるところだった。
romaji: karehateishishingou o mina kattanode, mou sukoshi de douro o wataro utoshiteita kodomo wohanerutokorodatta.
meaning: He didn't see the stop sign and almost hit the child crossing the street.

japanese: やっぱり男手があると、作業の幅が広がるねぇ。
romaji: yappari otokode gaaruto, sagyou no haba ga hiroga runee.
meaning: When there's a man around, the work that can be done sure increases.

japanese: 娘はいつも、約束を守らない母親に苛立っていた。
romaji: musume haitsumo, yakusoku o mamora nai hahaoya ni iradatsu teita.
meaning: The daughter was irritated with her mother, who always broke her promises.

japanese: 旅行に出かけるときにも同じ規則が当てはまる。
romaji: ryokou ni deka kerutokinimo onajikisoku ga ate hamaru.
meaning: The same rule applies to going for a journey.

japanese: これは早まる。
romaji: kore wa hayama ru.
meaning: This is to move forward, to hasten (vi.).

japanese: これは速まる。
romaji: kore wa hayama ru.
meaning: This is to quicken (vi.).

japanese: この新薬は君の回復を早めるかも知れない。
romaji: kono shinyaku wa kun no kaifuku o hayame rukamo shire nai.
meaning: This new medicine may aid your recovery.

japanese: 予鈴だ。校門の辺りにいた生徒たちが一斉に足を速める。
romaji: yorei da. koumon no atari niita seito tachiga issei ni ashi o hayame ru.
meaning: It's the class bell. The pupils that had been around the school gate quickened their steps as one.

japanese: これは払い込む。
romaji: kore wa haraikomu.
meaning: This is to pay.

japanese: これは腹が決まる。
romaji: kore wa hara ga kima ru.
meaning: This is to make up one's mind.

japanese: 腹が立つときは、１０まで数えなさい。
romaji: hara ga tatsu tokiha, 1 0 made kazoe nasai.
meaning: When angry, count to ten.

japanese: これは腹を決める。
romaji: kore wa hara o kime ru.
meaning: This is to make up one's mind.

japanese: 腹を立てるのも当たり前だな。
romaji: hara o tate runomo atarimae dana.
meaning: It's natural that she should get angry.

japanese: これは張り切る。
romaji: kore wa harikiru.
meaning: This is to be enthusiastic.

japanese: 彼らのコミュニケーションは我々が考えてきたものよりはるかに複雑かもしれません。
romaji: karera no komyunikeeshon wa wareware ga kangae tekitamonoyoriharukani fukuzatsu kamoshiremasen.
meaning: Their communication may be much more complex than we thought.

japanese: これは反～。
romaji: kore wa han ~.
meaning: This is anti-, inverse ～.

japanese: これは半～。
romaji: kore wa han ~.
meaning: This is half [short]-.

japanese: これは～版。
romaji: kore wa ~ han.
meaning: This is ～ edition [version].

japanese: 企業は、競合他社を業界内の狭い範囲で捉えて、本当のライバルを明確に理解してない場合が数多くあります。
romaji: kigyou ha, kyougoutasha o gyoukainai no semaihan'i de torae te, hontou no raibaru o meikaku ni rikai shitenai baai ga kazuooku arimasu.
meaning: Businesses perceive as competitors a narrow range of the business world; there are many cases where they don't understand their real rivals.

japanese: これは半永久的。
romaji: kore wa han'eikyuuteki.
meaning: This is semi-permanent.

japanese: これは～番組。
romaji: kore wa ~ bangumi.
meaning: This is ～ programme.

japanese: 彼の反抗的な態度に上司は腹を立てた。
romaji: kanohankoutekinataido ni joushi wa hara o tate ta.
meaning: It is his defiant attitude that made the chief angry.

japanese: これは犯罪防止。
romaji: kore wa hanzaiboushi.
meaning: This is crime prevention.

japanese: 私は反社会的かもしれないけれど人と話さないわけではない。
romaji: watashi wa hanshakaiteki kamoshirenaikeredo nin to hanasa naiwakedehanai.
meaning: I may be antisocial, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.

japanese: 私の知る限り、この化学薬品は細菌の繁殖を防ぐだろう。
romaji: watashi no shirukagiri, kono kagakuyakuhin wa saikin no hanshoku o fusegu darou.
meaning: To my knowledge, this chemical will prevent germs from breeding.

japanese: これは半世紀。
romaji: kore wa hanseiki.
meaning: This is half a century.

japanese: 夏には半そでシャツを着ます。
romaji: natsu niha han sode shatsu o chaku masu.
meaning: I wear short-sleeve shirts in the summer.

japanese: 湿気の多い気候はその半島の特色です。
romaji: shikke no ooikikou hasono hanshima no tokushoku desu.
meaning: A humid climate is characteristic of the peninsula.

japanese: これは半透明。
romaji: kore wa hantoumei.
meaning: This is translucent.

japanese: これは反時計回り。
romaji: kore wa hantokeimawari.
meaning: This is anti-clockwise.

japanese: 犯人だと思っていた男は事件とは何の関係もなかった。
romaji: hannin dato omotte ita otoko wa jiken toha nannokankei monakatta.
meaning: The man I thought was the criminal didn't have any connection to the incident.

japanese: これは犯人扱い。
romaji: kore wa hanninatsukai.
meaning: This is treated as a criminal.

japanese: マフィンを受ける数は、IRCでしゃべる回数に反比例して変化する。
romaji: mafin o ukerukazu ha, IRC deshaberu kaisuu ni hanpirei shite henkasu ru.
meaning: The number of muffins that you'll receive will be inversely proportional to the number of times you talk on IRC.

japanese: 大雨のため川がはんらんした。
romaji: ooame notame kawa gahanranshita.
meaning: The heavy rains caused the river to flood.

japanese: これは非～。
romaji: kore wa hi ~.
meaning: This is in-, non-, un-.

japanese: これは～費。
romaji: kore wa ~ hi.
meaning: This is expenses, costs.

japanese: 社屋や従業員に被害はなく、平常通り営業している。
romaji: shaoku ya juugyouin ni higai hanaku, heijoutourieigyou shiteiru.
meaning: There was no damage to the office, or workers, and we're in business as usual.

japanese: 被害届を出すためにきたのか？
romaji: higaitodoke o dasu tamenikitanoka ？
meaning: Have you come to file a damage report?

japanese: これはスキーとバーベキューとパーティーを日帰りで楽しむいいとこ取りの計画だ。
romaji: koreha sukii to baabekyuu to paateii o higaeri de tanoshi muiitoko tori no keikaku da.
meaning: Skiing, barbecues, parties: with this plan you get the best of everything and can enjoy it all on a one-day visit.

japanese: ５万円未満の場合は、非課税になります。
romaji: 5 man'enmiman no baai ha, hikazei ninarimasu.
meaning: It's tax-free in the case it's below ¥50,000.

japanese: 彼女の車はぴかぴかに磨いてある。
romaji: kanojo no kuruma hapikapikani migai tearu.
meaning: Her car has a nice polish.

japanese: これは引き～。
romaji: kore wa hiki ~.
meaning: This is (implies something involving pulling back, hauling, withdrawing, etc.).

japanese: 友に変わり彼はその責任を引き受けるつもりだ。
romaji: tomo ni kawarikareha sono sekinin o hikiuke rutsumorida.
meaning: He will take on the responsibility for his friends.

japanese: 人生という道を引き返すことはできない。
romaji: jinsei toiu michi o hikikaesu kotohadekinai.
meaning: There is no returning on the road of life.

japanese: 足し算は好きだけど引き算は嫌いだ。
romaji: tashizan wa suki dakedo hikizan wa kirai da.
meaning: I like addition but not subtraction.

japanese: 彼のいいところを引き出すようにしなさい。
romaji: kano iitokorowo hikidasu younishinasai.
meaning: Try to bring out the best in him.

japanese: 彼女は男の子を引き止める。
romaji: kanojo wa otokonoko o hikiyameru.
meaning: She holds the boy back.

japanese: 私は苦情を言ったが、店ではこのセーターを引き取るのを拒んだ。
romaji: watashi wa kujou o itta ga, mise dehakono seetaa o hikitoru nowo kyo nda.
meaning: I complained, but they refused to take this sweater back.

japanese: これはひきょう。
romaji: kore wa hikyou.
meaning: This is coward.

japanese: 試合は引き分けになった。
romaji: shiai wa hikiwake ninatta.
meaning: The game was drawn.

japanese: あんな本みたらフツーの女は引くもんな！
romaji: anna hon mitara futsuu no onna wa hiku monna!
meaning: Obviously a normal woman would lose interest if she saw a book like that!

japanese: ひげを生やしているせいなのか、一見怖そうなのに、実はやさしい人だ。
romaji: higewo haya shiteiruseinanoka, ikkenkowaso unanoni, jitsuha yasashii nin da.
meaning: Possibly because he's got a beard, he looks scary at first glance but he's really a kind man.

japanese: このエリアは、非公開です。
romaji: kono eria ha, hikoukai desu.
meaning: This area isn't open to the public.

japanese: 議長は自らの見解を非公式に述べるだけだろう。
romaji: gichou wa mizukara no kenkai o hikoushiki ni nobe rudakedarou.
meaning: The chairman would only make her comments off the record.

japanese: 日ごろご愛顧を賜り、まことにありがとうございます。
romaji: nichi gorogo aiko o tamawari, makotoniarigatougozaimasu.
meaning: We really thank you for your patronage.

japanese: これは被災～。
romaji: kore wa hisai ~.
meaning: This is disaster affected [damaged] ～.

japanese: 被災者に衣食を供給しなければならない。
romaji: hisaisha ni ishoku o kyoukyuu shinakerebanaranai.
meaning: We must provide food and clothes for the victims.

japanese: 被災地に救援物資が急送された。
romaji: hisaichi ni kyuuenbusshi ga kyuusou sareta.
meaning: Relief supplies were raced to the disaster area.

japanese: 彼女は手で目から日差しを遮った。
romaji: kanojo wa tedeme kara hizashi o sha tta.
meaning: She used her hand to screen the sunlight from her eyes.

japanese: ここは東京のビジネス街だ。
romaji: kokoha toukyou no bijinesu machi da.
meaning: This is a business section of Tokyo.

japanese: 父は自分の髪の刈り方について非常にやかましい。
romaji: chichi wa jibun no kami no karihou nitsuite hijouni yakamashii.
meaning: My father is very particular about the way his hair is cut.

japanese: 風邪を引かないようにビタミンＣをたっぷりとりなさい。
romaji: kaze o hika naiyouni bitamin C wotappuritorinasai.
meaning: Take lots of vitamin C to avoid catching cold.

japanese: これは引っ～。
romaji: kore wa hitsu ~.
meaning: This is (indicates actions involving getting trapped, being pulled, etc.).

japanese: そんなのに引っかかるのは間抜けだよ。
romaji: sonnanoni hitsu kakarunoha manuke dayo.
meaning: That's for suckers.

japanese: これは引っかく。
romaji: kore wa hitsu kaku.
meaning: This is to scratch.

japanese: 彼女は上着を引っかけると外へ出た。
romaji: kanojo wa uwagi o hitsu kakeruto soto e deta.
meaning: She threw on a coat and went outside.

japanese: これは筆記具。
romaji: kore wa hikkigu.
meaning: This is writing instruments.

japanese: 学生たちはアンフェアな筆記試験に抗議した。
romaji: gakusei tachiha anfea na hikkishiken ni kougi shita.
meaning: The students protested against the unfair exam.

japanese: これは引っ繰り返す。
romaji: kore wa hikikurikaesu.
meaning: This is to turn over.

japanese: 無理が通れば道理が引っ込む。
romaji: muri ga toure ba douri ga hitsukomu.
meaning: Might makes right.

japanese: 馬や羊が放牧されてて、牧羊犬もいるわ。一度訪ねてみてはどうかしら？
romaji: uma ya hitsuji ga houboku saretete, bokuyouinu moiruwa. ichidotazune temitehadoukashira ？
meaning: Sheep and horses are set out to pasture, there are sheepdogs too. How about giving it a visit once?

japanese: クリントン陣営は、両州でオバマが取った白人票を取り崩そうと必死になった。
romaji: kurinton jin'ei ha, ryoushuu de obama ga totsu ta hakujinhyou o torikuzuso uto hisshi ninatta.
meaning: The Clinton camp became desperate to eliminate the white votes Obama had got in both states.

japanese: さしずめ忍耐力に自信のない筆者などは、２，３時間で音をあげてしまう作業である。
romaji: sashizume nintairyoku ni jishin nonai hissha nadoha, 2, 3 jikan de oto woageteshimau sagyou dearu.
meaning: In fact, an artist lacking in confidence and fortitude would lose focus after 2 or 3 hours.

japanese: 夕立にあってびっしょりぬれた。
romaji: yuudachi niattebisshorinureta.
meaning: I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.

japanese: ボイラは湯あかがびっしりついた。
romaji: boira wa yu akagabisshiritsuita.
meaning: The boiler was heavily scaled.

japanese: 二人の姉妹はひっそりと暮らしていた。
romaji: futari no shimai hahissorito kurashi teita.
meaning: The two sisters lived very quietly.

japanese: 彼女は父親にぴったりとしがみついていた。
romaji: kanojo wa chichioya nipittaritoshigamitsuiteita.
meaning: She was clinging to her father.

japanese: 「これは何？供物か？」「そうだよ、このお賽銭箱の中に入れて・・・この紐を引っ張るの」
romaji: ( koreha nani ？ kumotsu ka ？) ( soudayo, konoo saisenhako no nakaniire te ・・・ kono himo o hipparu no)
meaning: "What is this? An offering?" "That's right. Put it in this offertory box ... and pull this rope."

japanese: むやみに自殺を否定しようとは思いませんが、親が子どもを道連れにするのはぜったいにやめてほしい、と思います。
romaji: muyamini jisatsu o hitei shiyoutoha omoi masenga, oya ga kodomo o michizure nisurunohazettainiyametehoshii, to omoi masu.
meaning: I don't intend to flatly reject suicide, but I really wish parents would not make their children join in with them.

japanese: 調べてみたら人違いだった。
romaji: shirabe temitara hitochigai datta.
meaning: When I inquired I found that it was the wrong person.

japanese: これは一つおき。
romaji: kore wa hitotsu oki.
meaning: This is every other.

japanese: 質問の回答として、充分じゃないのは分かってるんだけど、ひとまずこの答で。
romaji: shitsumon no kaitou toshite, juubun janainoha waka tterundakedo, hitomazukono kotae de.
meaning: I know this isn't an adequate answer to your question, but it's what I'll say for now.

japanese: 母は田舎で一人暮らしをしている。
romaji: haha wa inaka de hitorigurashi woshiteiru.
meaning: My mother lives a lonely life in the country.

japanese: 彼は一人っ子だったので、唯一の相続人だった。
romaji: karehahitorikko dattanode, yuiitsu no souzokunin datta.
meaning: Being an only child, he was the sole inheritor.

japanese: 兵士は穴の中に避難した。
romaji: heishi wa ana no nakanihinan shita.
meaning: The soldier took shelter in the foxhole.

japanese: 皮肉な笑いを浮かべて彼は私を見つめた。
romaji: hiniku na warai o uka bete karehawatashi o mitsu meta.
meaning: He stared at me with a satirical smile.

japanese: 僕は首をひねる。このポーンではなくて、こっちのナイトを・・・。
romaji: bokuhakubi wohineru. kono poon dehanakute, kotchino naito o ・・・.
meaning: I tilt my head. Not the pawn, but the knight?

japanese: 私を批判するのは止めて！
romaji: watashi o hihan surunoha tome te!
meaning: Stop criticizing me!

japanese: 劇の批評はおしなべて好評だった。
romaji: geki no hihyou haoshinabete kouhyou datta.
meaning: Almost all of the reviews of the play were favorable.

japanese: 暑い時は、首の後ろを冷やすといいんだって。
romaji: atsuitoki ha, kubi no ushiro o hiyasu toiindatte.
meaning: I hear that it's good to cool the back of your neck when it's hot.

japanese: 先ほどの彼らのやり取りにはひやひやしたよ。まさに一触即発の危機だったね。
romaji: saki hodono karera noyari tori nihahiyahiyashitayo. masani isshokusokuhatsu no kiki dattane.
meaning: I was really nervous to see how they dealt with each other just now. I guess things were touch-and-go between them.

japanese: 沈黙は同意を表す。
romaji: chinmoku wa doui o arawasu.
meaning: Silence gives consent.

japanese: これは～費用。
romaji: kore wa ~ hiyou.
meaning: This is ～ expenses.

japanese: 間食は美容に悪い。
romaji: kanshoku wa biyou ni warui.
meaning: Eating between meals is bad for the figure.

japanese: あなた同様私もヤフオクの評価が信じられません。
romaji: anata douyouwatashi mo yafuoku no hyouka ga shinji raremasen.
meaning: I also, same as you, don't trust Yahoo Auction ratings.

japanese: 彼女はいつも有名な美容師に髪を結ってもらう。
romaji: kanojo haitsumo yuumei na biyoushi ni kami o musutsu temorau.

japanese: これは優先度。
romaji: kore wa yuusendo.

japanese: 夕立にあってびっしょりぬれた。
romaji: yuudachi niattebisshorinureta.

japanese: 有能な連邦捜査局員はちゅうちょすることなく、自分の義務を実行する。
romaji: yuunou na renpousousakyokuin hachuuchosurukotonaku, jibun no gimu o jikkou suru.
meaning: An efficient FBI agent does not make any bones about carrying out his duties.

japanese: 有望な買い手は、契約内容をよく理解できませんでした。
romaji: yuubou na kaite ha, keiyakunaiyou woyoku rikai dekimasendeshita.

japanese: 有名人と知り合うチャンスがあるかしら。
romaji: yuumeijin to shiriau chansu gaarukashira.

japanese: 微笑みは、理解、喜び、あるいはユーモアを解したことを伝えることが出来る。
romaji: hohoemi ha, rikai, yorokobi, aruiha yuumoa o kaishi takotowo tsutae rukotoga dekiru.
meaning: A smile may convey understanding, joy, or an appreciation of humor.

japanese: どうせ、妙子さんが怖がって、有利さんも道連れにしようとしたんでしょ。
romaji: douse, taeko sanga kowaga tte, yuuri sanmo michizure nishiyoutoshitandesho.

japanese: 壊れた湯飲みの補充をした。

romaji: yoake ninatte hajimetekarehanetsu ita.
meaning: It was not till daybreak that he went to sleep.

japanese: そういえば、電車の中で隣に座ったほろ酔いのおっさんに、自分の俳句を見て欲しいと言われたことがある。
romaji: souieba, densha no naka de tonari ni suwatsu tahoro yoi noossanni, jibun no haiku o mitehoshii to iwa retakotogaaru.
meaning: Now that I think of it, I've been asked to look at a haiku he'd written by the tipsy bloke sitting next to me on the train.

japanese: 彼は酔うと手がつけられない。

meaning: He is out of control when drunk.

japanese: これは～用。
romaji: kore wa ~ you.

japanese: 陽気な席で、人気者の隣に、興ざめの者が座っていることがよくある。
romaji: youki na seki de, ninkimono no tonari ni, kyouza meno mono ga suwatsu teirukotogayokuaru.
meaning: At a hilarious party, one frequently finds a wet blanket sitting next to the life of the party.

japanese: その会社では高い専門性が要求される。
romaji: sono kaisha deha takaisenmonsei ga youkyuu sareru.
meaning: A high degree of specialization is required in that company.

japanese: これは洋食。
romaji: kore wa youshoku.
meaning: This is Western food.

japanese: それにしても、幼稚園というところは、季節の行事にとても敏感です。
romaji: sorenishitemo, youchien toiutokoroha, kisetsu no gyouji nitotemo binkan desu.
meaning: Even so, kindergartens are sensitive to seasonal events.

japanese: 幼稚園児たちは手をつないで公園の中を歩いていた。
romaji: youchienji tachiha te wotsunaide kouen no naka o arui teita.
meaning: The kindergarten children were walking hand in hand in the park.

japanese: その発見はいろいろな用途に応用できる。
romaji: sono hakken hairoirona youto ni ouyou dekiru.
meaning: We can apply the discovery to various uses.

japanese: 私は洋風の家に住んでいます。
romaji: watashi wa youfuu no ie ni sun deimasu.
meaning: I live in a Western-style house.

japanese: 今、ようやくツケがまわってきたのだろう。
romaji: ima, youyaku tsuke gamawattekitanodarou.
meaning: So it's finally time to pay the piper.

japanese: 妹は要領が悪くて損ばかりしている。
romaji: imouto wa youryou ga waruku te son bakarishiteiru.
meaning: My sister is clumsy, which is a disadvantage to her.

japanese: 預金したいのですが。
romaji: yokin shitainodesuga.
meaning: I want to deposit some money.

japanese: これは～預金。

japanese: 余計なことをして、すみません。
romaji: yokei nakotowoshite, sumimasen.
meaning: Sorry, that was none of my business.

japanese: このシート、本革ですね。間違って汚すと大変なことになりそうです。
romaji: kono shiito, honkawa desune. machigatsu te yogosu to taihen nakotoninarisoudesu.
meaning: This seat, it's real leather, isn't it? It would be a disaster if some slip-up gets it dirtied.

japanese: 予算案は上院を通過した。
romaji: yosan'an wa jouin o tsuuka shita.
meaning: The budget passed the Upper House.

japanese: おまわりさんに車を片側に寄せるように合図された。
romaji: omawarisanni kuruma o katagawa ni yose ruyouni aizu sareta.
meaning: The patrolman motioned me to pull over.

japanese: 彼女の返答はいつも私の予想通りだ。
romaji: kanojo no hentou haitsumo watashi no yosoudoori da.
meaning: Her answer corresponds to my expectation.

japanese: たった一センチで酔っ払いますか！健介は酒豪だったと言うのに。
romaji: tatta ichi senchi de yotsuharai masuka! kensuke wa shugou dattato iu noni.
meaning: You get drunk on just one centimeter? And Kensuke was such a heavy drinker.

japanese: よっぽどの自信なんだなぁ。
romaji: yoppodono jishin nandanaa.
meaning: You have considerable confidence.

japanese: アップルの新型ノートは予定通りに発表されるだろうか。
romaji: appuru no shingata nooto wa yoteidoori ni happyou sarerudarouka.
meaning: Will Apple's new model notebook be announced on schedule?

japanese: 安倍内閣は、自由民主党、公明党を与党とする連立内閣である。
romaji: abenaikaku ha, jiyuuminshutou, koumeitou o yotou tosuru renritsunaikaku dearu.
meaning: The Abe Cabinet is a coalition Cabinet where the Liberal Democratic Party and New Komei Party form the government.

japanese: 夏休みの間、私は夜中に夕食を食べていた。
romaji: natsuyasumi no kan, watashi wa yonaka ni yuushoku o tabete ita.
meaning: During summer breaks, I ate dinner at midnight.

japanese: ことあるごとに呼び出すのはやめてちょうだい。
romaji: kotoarugotoni yobidasu nohayametechoudai.
meaning: Could you please stop calling me at every opportunity you can get?

japanese: 余分な金はない。
romaji: yobun na kin hanai.
meaning: We have no spare money.

japanese: 流感の予防ワクチンの注射をした。
romaji: ryuukan no yobou wakuchin no chuusha woshita.
meaning: I was vaccinated against the flu.

japanese: これは予防法。
romaji: kore wa yobouhou.
meaning: This is how to prevent.

japanese: 父は今年喜寿を迎えたが、わたしなんかよりよほどエネルギッシュだ。
romaji: chichi wa konnenkiju o mukae taga, watashinankayoriyohodo enerugisshu da.
meaning: My father celebrated his seventieth birthday this year, but he's more energetic than I am.

japanese: これは読み直す。
romaji: kore wa yominaosu.
meaning: This is to reread.

japanese: 彼は彼女の弱気を叱った。
romaji: karehakanojo no yowaki o shikatsu ta.
meaning: He scolded her for her weakness.

japanese: １９世紀になる英語圏の国ではマスターベーションにより、記憶力が弱まる、注意力が散漫になるとよく言われていた。
romaji: 1 9 seiki ninaru eigoken no kuni deha masutaabeeshon niyori, kiokuryoku ga yowama ru, chuuiryoku ga sanman ninarutoyoku iwa reteita.
meaning: In the English world of the 19th century, it was often said that masturbation would lead to a loss of memory and attention.

japanese: 彼の弱みに付け込むのはやめなさい。
romaji: kanoyowami ni tsukekomu nohayamenasai.
meaning: Stop taking advantage of his weakness.

japanese: 何故イギリスだけが王権を弱めることに成功したのか。
romaji: naze igirisu dakega ouken o yowame rukotoni seikou shitanoka.
meaning: Why is it that only England succeeded in abridging the King's power?

japanese: これは四歳児。
romaji: kore wa yonsaiji.
meaning: This is four-year-old child.

japanese: これは～らしい。
romaji: kore wa ~ rashii.
meaning: This is look, seem.

japanese: 彼女はラッシュアワーを避けるために早く出発した。
romaji: kanojo wa rasshuawaa o sake rutameni hayakushuppatsu shita.
meaning: She started early in order to avoid the rush hour.

japanese: 乱暴な言葉を使ってはいけない。
romaji: ranbou na kotoba o tsukatte haikenai.
meaning: Don't be rough in speech.

japanese: 両者の利害の調整を図りつつ、国際的視野に立った人口政策を考えていかなければならない。
romaji: ryousha no rigai no chousei o hakari tsutsu, kokusaitekishiya ni tatsu ta jinkouseisaku o kangae teikanakerebanaranai.
meaning: A population policy should be considered on the international viewpoint so as to balance the interests of both sides.

japanese: 陸と水で地球の表面は出来ている。
romaji: riku to mizu de chikyuu no hyoumen wa dekite iru.
meaning: Land and water make up the earth's surface.

japanese: 両親が離婚したため、その少女はほとんど父親との接触がなかった。
romaji: ryoushin ga rikon shitatame, sono shoujo hahotondo chichioya tono sesshoku ganakatta.
meaning: Because the parents divorced, the girl had little contact with the father.

japanese: 自然環境の回復を宣伝する組織がリサイクルに力を入れて、植林に貢献しないのは何故か。
romaji: shizenkankyou no kaifuku o senden suru soshiki ga risaikuru ni chikara o ire te, shokurin ni kouken shinainoha nazeka.
meaning: Since many organizations are putting effort into recycling in order to restore the natural environment, why won't you contribute to reforestation?

japanese: 彼女はそのローンに７％の利子を払った。
romaji: kanojo hasono roon ni 7 % no rishi o haratsu ta.
meaning: She paid seven percent interest on the loan.

japanese: 理想を絵に描いたような男性だった。
romaji: risou o e ni egai tayouna dansei datta.
meaning: He was a man who was the very picture of her ideals.

japanese: ニュービジネスアイディアの開発は誰もが望む理想的なことだろう。
romaji: nyuubijinesuaidia no kaihatsu wa daremo ga nozomurisouteki nakotodarou.
meaning: The development of a new business idea is no doubt the ideal that everybody wishes for.

japanese: 彼は利息を付けて借金払いをした。

japanese: これは立方体。

japanese: これは～量。

japanese: これは両わき。

japanese: これは～力。

japanese: 彼はギターを弾いているとリラックスできる。
romaji: kareha gitaa o hii teiruto rirakkusu dekiru.
meaning: He feels relaxed when he's playing the guitar.

japanese: 君らしくないかも知れないが、せめて礼儀くらい守ったらどうだ。
romaji: kun rashikunaikamo shire naiga, semete reigi kurai mamotsu taradouda.
meaning: You could at least try to be a bit more polite, even though it's not like you.

japanese: 礼儀正しいのが彼の特徴であった。
romaji: reigitadashi inoga kanotokuchou deatta.
meaning: Courtesy marked his manner.

japanese: 冷静に考えて見ろよ！
romaji: reisei ni kangae te miro yo!
meaning: Get real!

japanese: 彼女はここにレジャーで来たのですか。
romaji: kanojo hakokoni rejaa de kita nodesuka.
meaning: Did she come here to relax?

japanese: これは～連合。
romaji: kore wa ~ rengou.
meaning: This is ～ union [coalition].

japanese: 労働組合は経営陣と交渉している。
romaji: roudoukumiai wa keieijin to koushou shiteiru.
meaning: The labor union is negotiating with the owners.

japanese: そのため、派遣労働者は劣悪な労働条件の下で働いている。
romaji: sonotame, hakenroudousha wa retsuaku na roudoujouken no shita de hatarai teiru.
meaning: For that reason, temporary workers are working under inferior conditions.

japanese: 彼女はそのローンに７％の利子を払った。
romaji: kanojo hasono roon ni 7 % no rishi o haratsu ta.
meaning: She paid seven percent interest on the loan.

japanese: 彼らはロンドン行きを中止した。
romaji: karera wa rondon iki o chuushi shita.
meaning: They called off their visit to London.

japanese: 「すべき」というのは、現在形で書かれている論文も散見されるからです。
romaji: ( subeki) toiunoha, genzaikei de kaka reteiru ronbun mo sanken sarerukaradesu.
meaning: I say "should", because theses written in the present tense are still seen around and about.

japanese: 本人は唯我独尊を決め込んでいるようだけども、周りから見れば単なるわがままだよね。
romaji: honnin wa yuigadokuson o kimekon deiruyoudakedomo, mawari kara mire ba tannaru wagamamadayone.
meaning: He's completely convinced of his own greatness but to the people around him he's just a selfish jerk.

japanese: ふふ・・・いわくがあるのさ、あそこには。
romaji: fufu ・・・ iwakugaarunosa, asokoniha.
meaning: He-heh... there's a tale behind that, for that place.

japanese: 枠が出来上がると、クモはちょうど自転車の車輪のやのように、それに絹の糸をかける。
romaji: waku ga dekiaga ruto, kumo hachoudo jitensha no sharin noyanoyouni, soreni kinu no ito wokakeru.
meaning: When the frame is finished, the spider fixes lines of silk across it, just like the spokes of a bicycle wheel.

japanese: わざとやったのね！
romaji: wazatoyattanone!
meaning: You did this intentionally!

japanese: こんなに明らかなことをわざわざどうやって説明したらいいのか分からない。
romaji: konnani akiraka nakotowowazawazadouyatte setsumeishi taraiinoka waka ranai.
meaning: I don't know how to demonstrate it, since it's too obvious!

japanese: 和食のレストランへ行くたびに、割り箸を家へもって帰ります。
romaji: washoku no resutoran e iku tabini, waribashi o ie hemotte kaeri masu.
meaning: Whenever I go to a Japanese restaurant, I take the disposable chopsticks home with me.

japanese: 貧しい人とはほんのわずかしか持っていない人ではなく欲のありすぎる人である。
romaji: mazushiinin tohahonnowazukashika motsu teinai nin dehanaku yoku noarisugiru nin dearu.
meaning: Poor is not the one who has too little, but the one who wants too much.

japanese: 綿は水を吸収する。
romaji: men wa mizu o kyuushuu suru.
meaning: Cotton absorbs water.

japanese: 信じていたかどうかはともかく、超常的な話題に拒絶反応があるということはないようだ。
romaji: shinji teitakadoukahatomokaku, choujoutekinawadai ni kyozetsuhannou gaarutoiukotohanaiyouda.
meaning: I don't know whether she believed me or not but in any case it seems she doesn't automatically dismiss talk of the supernatural.

japanese: 梅酒はね、梅で作る和風リキュールのことだよ。
romaji: umeshu hane, ume de tsukuruwafuu rikyuuru nokotodayo.
meaning: Umeshu is a Japanese liqueur made from plums.

japanese: これは笑いかける。
romaji: kore wa warai kakeru.
meaning: This is to smile, to grin.

japanese: 彼らは１時間３マイルの割合で歩いた。
romaji: karera wa 1 jikan 3 mairu no wariai de arui ta.
meaning: They walked at the rate of three miles an hour.

japanese: 支払いは割り勘にしよう。
romaji: shiharai wa warikan nishiyou.
meaning: Let's split the bill.

japanese: 何らかの数字をゼロで割り算すると未定義の解になる。
romaji: nanraka no suuji o zero de warizan suruto miteigi no kai ninaru.
meaning: The result of dividing any number by zero is undefined.

japanese: 割とありうる。
romaji: wato ariuru.
meaning: It's quite possible.

japanese: 「あれ、タンジェントってサインでコサインを割るんだっけ？」「逆、逆」
romaji: ( are, tanjiento tte sain de kosain o waru ndakke ？) ( gyaku, gyaku)
meaning: "Eh? Is the tangent cosine divided by sine?" "Other way round!"

japanese: 湾にはたくさんのボートと人がいる。
romaji: wan nihatakusanno booto to nin gairu.
meaning: The bay is full of boats and people.

japanese: ブルース夫人は英日間を飛んだ最初の女性パイロットであった。
romaji: buruusu fujin wa einichikan o ton da saisho no josei pairotto deatta.
meaning: Mrs. Bruce was the first female pilot to fly between England and Japan.

japanese: トランジスターの発明は新時代を画した。
romaji: toranjisutaa no hatsumei wa shinjidai o ga shita.
meaning: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
